The Drilldown apps let you browse telemetry data without writing any queries. In this milestone, you navigate to the Drilldown area and see how the apps present data.

To navigate to a Drilldown app, complete the following steps:

1. In the Grafana Cloud main menu, click **Drilldown**.
   The Drilldown area opens, showing the available Drilldown apps.
2. Click **Metrics Drilldown** (or any available Drilldown app).
   The app opens, showing a visual interface for browsing data. Notice that there is no query editor; the app presents data using visual filters and navigation instead.
3. Browse the interface. You can see metrics organized visually without needing to write any query language.

You've now seen what a Drilldown app looks like: a signal-specific interface with visual filters, designed for queryless exploration.

In the next milestone, you complete the tour.
